sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates via Frankfurter (annual average of daily rates, LCU per USD)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Calderón wins disputed election
geopolitical_news.summary: July vote gives the PAN candidate a narrow win; López Obrador cries fraud and leads mass protests.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drug war begins in Michoacán
geopolitical_news.summary: A December military operation in Michoacán launches Calderón's cartel crackdown as violence starts to climb.

sport.headline: World Cup ends in extra time
sport.summary: Mexico falls to Argentina in the round of 16 on a stunning late goal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cartel violence escalates
geopolitical_news.summary: Drug war killings surge across northern Mexico as the military takes on trafficking organizations through the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mérida Initiative proposed
geopolitical_news.summary: US offers security aid worth hundreds of millions to Mexico in an October anti-drug pact.

sport.headline: Gold Cup final loss to the US
sport.summary: Mexico falls 2-1 to the Americans in the Chicago final in June after leading early.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pemex reform battle
geopolitical_news.summary: Calderón pushes a limited oil reform through Congress in October amid protests over the state monopoly.

geopolitical_news.headline: Juárez becomes murder capital
geopolitical_news.summary: Cartel wars turn Ciudad Juárez into one of the world's deadliest cities as killings soar.

sport.headline: Taekwondo golds at Beijing
sport.summary: Mexico wins two taekwondo golds in August, its only titles of the Beijing Olympics.

geopolitical_news.headline: Swine flu outbreak alarms world
geopolitical_news.summary: H1N1 emerges in Mexico in April; schools close and travel stalls as the WHO declares a pandemic.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drug war rages on
geopolitical_news.summary: Massacres and military operations continue as cartel violence spreads nationwide with no end in sight.

sport.headline: Mexico routs US in Gold Cup final
sport.summary: El Tri thrashes the Americans 5-0 in July at the Meadowlands to lift the continental crown.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drug war's bloodiest year
geopolitical_news.summary: Massacres, including 72 migrants, mark a peak in cartel violence as the death toll climbs.

geopolitical_news.headline: PRI surges in midterms
geopolitical_news.summary: July elections signal the PRI's comeback ahead of 2012 as voters punish the PAN over the drug war.

sport.headline: Another World Cup, same exit
sport.summary: Mexico falls to Argentina again in the South Africa round of 16 in June.

geopolitical_news.headline: Violence grinds on
geopolitical_news.summary: Cartel killings continue at record pace; the August Monterrey casino attack kills dozens, shocking the nation.

geopolitical_news.headline: Guadalajara hosts Pan Am Games
geopolitical_news.summary: The October Pan American Games showcase Guadalajara despite security worries, drawing thousands of athletes from across the Americas.

sport.headline: Mexico wins U-17 World Cup
sport.summary: El Tri's youngsters lift the trophy on home soil in July, beating Uruguay in the final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peña Nieto returns PRI to power
geopolitical_news.summary: July victory ends 12 years of PAN rule; the Pact for Mexico follows in December.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pact for Mexico signed
geopolitical_news.summary: Parties agree a reform agenda in a December deal covering energy, education and telecoms.

sport.headline: Olympic football gold at London
sport.summary: Mexico beats Brazil 2-1 at Wembley in August for its first Olympic football title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Energy reform opens Pemex
geopolitical_news.summary: A December constitutional reform ends Pemex's decades-old oil monopoly, inviting foreign investment for the first time in 75 years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vigilantes rise in Michoacán
geopolitical_news.summary: Self-defense groups take up arms against the Knights Templar cartel as the state loses control.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying scare
sport.summary: Mexico squeezes into Brazil 2014 via a playoff against New Zealand after a dismal campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ayotzinapa students disappear
geopolitical_news.summary: September abduction of 43 students in Guerrero sparks national outrage, implicating local officials in a still-unsolved mystery.

geopolitical_news.headline: Energy reform enacted
geopolitical_news.summary: Secondary laws in August open oil and power to private firms, implementing the constitutional overhaul amid leftist protests.

sport.headline: Quinto partido curse continues
sport.summary: Mexico falls to the Netherlands in the World Cup round of 16 on a late controversial penalty.

geopolitical_news.headline: El Chapo escapes prison
geopolitical_news.summary: July tunnel escape from a maximum-security jail humiliates the government; he is recaptured in 2016.

geopolitical_news.headline: Midterms weaken Peña Nieto
geopolitical_news.summary: June elections cost the PRI ground amid scandals and slow growth, as independents make history.

sport.headline: Gold Cup champions again
sport.summary: Mexico beats Jamaica in the July final to reclaim the CONCACAF crown.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump victory rattles Mexico
geopolitical_news.summary: November US election threatens the wall, deportations and NAFTA's future, sending the peso tumbling to record lows.

geopolitical_news.headline: Gasolinazo protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: January fuel price hikes spark riots and looting nationwide as subsidies end under the energy reform.

sport.headline: Canelo knocks out Khan
sport.summary: Saúl Álvarez's brutal sixth-round KO in Las Vegas in May cements his stardom in a middleweight showcase.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump pressures Mexico on wall
geopolitical_news.summary: Wall demands and NAFTA threats dominate a tense bilateral year as renegotiation talks begin in August.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly September earthquakes
geopolitical_news.summary: Twin September quakes kill hundreds, toppling buildings across Mexico City in the year's worst disaster.

sport.headline: Chicharito becomes top scorer
sport.summary: Javier Hernández passes Hugo Sánchez as Mexico's all-time leading scorer with his 47th international goal.

geopolitical_news.headline: AMLO wins in a landslide
geopolitical_news.summary: July victory gives Morena the presidency and Congress with a sweeping majority; the old order crumbles.

geopolitical_news.headline: USMCA replaces NAFTA
geopolitical_news.summary: September deal with Washington and Ottawa preserves North American trade after a year of brinkmanship in a trilateral pact.

sport.headline: Mexico stuns Germany at World Cup
sport.summary: El Tri beats the defending champions 1-0 in June in the Moscow opener.

geopolitical_news.headline: AMLO's first year
geopolitical_news.summary: Austerity, referendums and mega-projects define a polarizing debut in power as institutions bend to his will.

geopolitical_news.headline: Culiacán chaos over El Chapo's son
geopolitical_news.summary: October operation to catch Ovidio Guzmán collapses amid cartel gunfire, forcing his release in a national humiliation.

sport.headline: Gold Cup win over the US
sport.summary: Mexico beats the Americans 1-0 in the Chicago final in July to reclaim regional bragging rights.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 batters Mexico
geopolitical_news.summary: One of the world's highest death tolls as hospitals overflow through a grim year with limited testing.

geopolitical_news.headline: General Cienfuegos arrested, then freed
geopolitical_news.summary: US drug arrest of the ex-defense chief strains ties in November; Mexico drops charges.

sport.headline: Liga MX season cancelled
sport.summary: The Clausura 2020 tournament is scrapped in May as the pandemic halts football, with no champion crowned.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morena holds Congress in midterms
geopolitical_news.summary: June vote keeps AMLO's majority but costs him Mexico City ground to the opposition.

geopolitical_news.headline: Metro Line 12 collapse kills 26
geopolitical_news.summary: May overpass collapse in a rush-hour disaster exposes corruption and negligence, shocking the capital.

sport.headline: Olympic football bronze at Tokyo
sport.summary: Mexico beats Japan in August to take bronze in the men's tournament, repeating London's podium magic.

geopolitical_news.headline: Energy reform fails in Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: April defeat blocks AMLO's bid to restore state power dominance in a major legislative loss.

geopolitical_news.headline: Journalist killings spark outcry
geopolitical_news.summary: A deadly year for reporters across the country draws US and EU condemnation as impunity persists.

sport.headline: World Cup streak snapped
sport.summary: Mexico exits in the group stage, missing the knockouts for the first time since 1978.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sheinbaum chosen as successor
geopolitical_news.summary: Morena taps the Mexico City mayor in September to carry AMLO's project into 2024.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nearshoring boom transforms north
geopolitical_news.summary: Factories multiply as US firms shift supply chains, making Mexico America's top trade partner.

sport.headline: Gold Cup title in Las Vegas
sport.summary: Mexico beats Panama in the July final to win the regional crown.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sheinbaum elected first woman president
geopolitical_news.summary: A June landslide makes Claudia Sheinbaum Mexico's first woman president, continuing Morena's dominance with a broad mandate.

geopolitical_news.headline: Judicial reform sparks alarm
geopolitical_news.summary: September reform to elect judges draws market jitters and US warnings as the peso slides amid investor unease.

sport.headline: Copa América early exit
sport.summary: Mexico crashes out in the group stage in June, costing the coach his job.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sheinbaum navigates Trump 2.0
geopolitical_news.summary: Tariff threats and cartel pressure test the new president in a tense bilateral year with Washington.

geopolitical_news.headline: Security crackdown intensifies
geopolitical_news.summary: Operations against cartels multiply through 2025 with high-profile arrests and extraditions as the US demands results.

sport.headline: Gold Cup glory over the US
sport.summary: Mexico beats the Americans 2-1 in the Houston final in July to defend the regional title.
